description: This file provides a Windows-specific wrapper around filesystem operations, implementing functions to open files, create directories, stat files, and read symbolic links using the Windows API with UTF-8 support.

methods.name: int fs_win32_openUTF8(const char * path,int oflag,int pmode)
methods.description: Opens a file with a UTF-8 encoded path on Windows, converting the path to wide characters and invoking the Windows _wopen API.

methods.name: int fs_win32_mkdirUTF8(const char * path,mode_t mode)
methods.description: Creates a directory with a UTF-8 encoded path on Windows, converting to wide characters and calling _wmkdir.

methods.name: int fs_win32_stati64UTF8(const char * path,struct fs_win32_stati64UTF8 * st)
methods.description: Obtain file status information for a UTF-8 path, handling trailing slashes and converting path to wide characters before calling _wstati64.

methods.name: int fs_win32_readlinkUTF8(const char * path,char * result,size_t rsz)
methods.description: Reads the symbolic link target of a file or directory specified with a UTF-8 path, using Windows API functions to resolve the link.

ctags.name: fs_win32_openUTF8
ctags.pattern: /^int fs_win32_openUTF8 (const char *path, int oflag, int pmode)$/
